description: 電信事業普及服務提供數據通信接取服務之特定村里 [telecommunications] is a dataset listed in Government Open Data Platform of Taiwan (data.gov.tw), an open data portal, published or maintained by 數位發展部. 電信事業普及服務管理辦法規定之提供數據通信接取普及服務之指定特定村里，提供予民間或有關單位運用，期望藉此為研究或統計提供更多元的資料，使民眾瞭解電信普及服務的執行狀況。. Coverage: Taiwan. The portal files it under the publisher 數位發展部. Its tags are 交通及通訊. It offers 1 resource(s) in csv. The portal shows 2025-12-23 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Chinese; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is 政府資料開放授權條款-第1版. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support telecommunication coverage and network deployment studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-tw-dgt-portal.
